subject.title: [Bug]: opencode-go works via direct infer but fails in embedded agent runtime with session takeover

question: Should this issue require live `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5` embedded agent proof before closure, or is the generic session-takeover recovery in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039 sufficient once merged?
rationale: The current source supports the reported failure class, but the open recovery PR addresses a broader takeover/message-loss path and does not directly prove the provider-specific Telegram/dashboard flow; automation should not choose that proof boundary alone.

options.title: Require live OpenCode Go embedded proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a merged fix or maintainer validation covers direct inference, first embedded turn, follow-up turn, and a tool-call turn for `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5`.

options.title: Accept the generic recovery proof
options.body: Close this after the broader recovery PR lands if maintainers consider its deterministic session-takeover proof sufficient for this provider-specific report.

options.title: Split a narrower follow-up
options.body: Land or close the generic recovery work separately and open a new provider-specific validation issue for any remaining OpenCode Go behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live OpenCode Go embedded proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a merged fix or maintainer validation covers direct inference, first embedded turn, follow-up turn, and a tool-call turn for `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner to both session-lock maintenance and OpenCode Go provider integration decisions.
